يبتهجا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَهِجَا (yabtahijā) /jab.ta.hi.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# يُبْتَهَجَا (yubtahajā) /jub.ta.ha.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
